data.description:
## Incident Overview
PR #240 (cleanup/change-detector-deletions-152416) adds a table of common misapplications to `plugins/dso/skills/shared/prompts/behavioral-testing-standard.md`. Row 8 of the table uses `grep -q "enforcement.strategy=ci"` as an example 'Contract test'. This string matches the legacy config key pattern `enforcement\.strategy`, causing `test_no_legacy_key_refs_in_scope_files` in `test-legacy-cleanup-grep.sh` to fail.

## Error
```
FAIL: test_no_legacy_key_refs_in_scope_files
  Legacy config key references found outside the allowlist.
  These files must be updated to use the new config key names:
    plugins/dso/skills/shared/prompts/behavioral-testing-standard.md
```

## Root Cause (pre-investigation)
The PR introduced `enforcement.strategy` (a legacy key) into a documentation example table in a skills prompt file.
